meta.title: Saad Bin Waqas, builder of drones, robots and games
meta.description: Saad Bin Waqas builds drones, sumo robots, Unity games and software in Lahore, Pakistan. NERC sumo semi-finalist, RobotMEA sumo and soccer winner, youngest participant at SOFTEC'23.

hero.line: I build things that {fly}, {fight} and {follow lines}.
hero.sub: Drones, sumo robots, Unity games and the code in between, from a workbench in Lahore.

about.title: From cardboard to carbon fibre

left.label: Where it started
left.title: Cardboard
left.text: My first competition robots were popsicle sticks, layers of corrugated cardboard and an Arduino. One of them won a soccer final.

image.alt: Top view of a small four-wheeled robot built from popsicle sticks and cardboard, with an Arduino Uno, a red motor driver and a LiPo battery, on a blue table

right.label: Where it is now
right.title: Carbon fibre
right.text: The newest build is a 5-inch FPV quad, soldered from bare parts, tuned in Betaflight and flown by me. In between I picked up Unity, Blender, CAD, Python and TypeScript.

about.statement: RobotMEA gave me its Emerging Star Award for doing every project on my own, without a teacher's help. That is still how I work: pick something I can't build yet, then build it.

fly.title: Fly
fly.intro: Quads on three different flight controllers, and one RC plane.

build.name: 5-inch FPV quad
build.tag: SpeedyBee F405 on a Mark4 frame
build.text: Fully soldered and assembled from scratch. Betaflight configured for modes, rates, OSD and RPM filters, motors calibrated, BLHeli_32 tuned, failsafe verified.

image.alt: Hand-drawn wiring diagram in blue pen on ruled paper: flight controller in the middle, camera, receiver, battery and video transmitter around it

notebook.caption: The wiring plan, before any solder.

Space Shooter gameplay with laser fire

ship.title: Ship
ship.intro: Software for people in Pakistan who sell things and need them to arrive.

codshield.name: CODShield
codshield.text: Most online orders here are paid in cash at the door. When nobody opens it, the seller pays the courier both ways and gets nothing. CODShield is a back office that spots those orders before the parcel leaves.

points.title: Chat that takes the order
points.text: In English, Urdu or Roman Urdu. Prices and stock come from the database, never from the AI or the customer.

points.title: Address cleaning
points.text: Tidies Pakistani addresses using a list of local areas and spellings.

points.title: Risk score with reasons
points.text: Simple, readable rules. Every score is saved with why.

points.title: A human when it matters
points.text: Shaky orders get a confirmation call. If the AI is stuck, staff take over the chat.

chat.text: Ji zaroor! Kaunsa size, aur delivery kahan karni hai?
medium. hous 12 st 4 dha ph 5 lhr
1 shirt, medium, cash on delivery. Confirm kar doon?

ragnready.name: ragNready
ragnready.text: A storefront for baby clothes and newborn gifts in Pakistan, with cash on delivery, order alerts on WhatsApp and an admin the shop owner can run alone.
